# Snaglist

> A single JavaScript file, with no libraries, that adds a "Send feedback" button to any website or web app.
> People report bugs and UX problems, suggest features and improvements, record a series of steps, or check the
> page for accessibility problems. Each report is tagged with the page and the part of it, carries the technical
> details needed to act on it (text on screen, script errors with stack, console errors and warnings, failed and
> slow requests, recorded steps, styles and contrast, layout, accessibility details, sanitised HTML, Core Web
> Vitals), and keeps no personal information: never what people type, no cookies or query strings; emails, long
> numbers, IP addresses and keys are replaced. People are shown the whole report before it is sent. MIT licence.

## Quickest install

The set-up tool, https://themightytrex.github.io/snaglist/configure.html, asks what the site needs and writes
snaglist-start.js, the script tags for the platform, and one prompt for an AI assistant.

## Install (any site)

1. Download https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheMightyTRex/snaglist/main/snaglist.js into the folder the site
   serves static files from (public/ or static/ in most frameworks). Do not change it.
2. Create snaglist-start.js next to it:
   (function start(tries) {
     if (!window.Snaglist) { if (tries < 100) setTimeout(start, 50, tries + 1); return; }
     Snaglist.start({ app: "App name", language: "en-GB", send: { github: { repo: "owner/name" } } });
   })(0);
3. Before </body> in the shared layout, snaglist.js first:
   <script src="/snaglist.js" defer></script>
   <script src="/snaglist-start.js" defer></script>
   Shortest form instead: <script src="/snaglist.js" data-github="owner/name" defer></script>
   (optional data-types="bug ux feature check", data-email, data-endpoint, data-app, data-version)
4. Add data-component="name" to main parts of pages (header, menus, forms, cards, tables, dialogs).
5. Add data-snag-private to anything that shows personal details.
6. Never put a token or password in the page; Snaglist does not need one.

## Settings (all optional)

language ("auto" reads <html lang>; "en-US" uses US spelling; any other language: translate with text),
theme ("light" default | "dark" | "auto"), enabled (true), userToggle (true), launcher ("bottom-right" |
"bottom-left" | false), shortcut ("" or "Alt+Shift+F"),
types (["bug", "ux", "visual", "accessibility", "performance", "content", "feature", "idea", "other", "check"],
or objects { id, label, hint, group: "problem" | "suggestion", pick, scale, fields: [{ id, label, hint,
type: "textarea" | "text" | "select", options, required }], collect: [parts] }),
check ({ engine: "built-in" | "axe", axe: url, contrastLimit: 300 }),
categories (null | "ux" | "heuristics" | "wcag" | [[value, label, hint]]), severities ("three" | "nielsen" |
list), importance ("importance" | list), labels (["feedback"]),
collect (each true | false | "auto": page, element, text, steps, styles, layout, a11y, html, environment,
display, performance, errors, console, network, trail, context),
limits { errors: 5, console: 10, network: 8, trail: 8, slowRequest: 2000 }, page { name: fn, keepParams: [] },
component { attribute: "data-component", from: fn }, context (fn returning app details such as a build number),
redact ([[regex, "[label]"]]), send { github: { repo, labels }, email: { to, subject }, endpoint: { url,
headers }, qr: true, copy: true, download: true }, beforeSend (fn(report) => report), text ({ key: "replacement" }).

## Translating

Snaglist.strings() returns every interface string by key (about 170). Translate the values and pass them as
text: { key: "translation" } with language: "<code>". Keys left out stay in English. Right-to-left languages are
laid out right to left.

## Functions

Snaglist.start(settings), Snaglist.destroy({ forget }), Snaglist.open(type), Snaglist.report(element, type),
Snaglist.setUserEnabled(on), Snaglist.isUserEnabled(), Snaglist.redact(text), Snaglist.strings(),
Snaglist.version.

## User setting (recommended)

A switch labelled "Show Send feedback", on by default, with the hint "A button for sending feedback or
reporting a problem on any page. Reports never include your personal details." Off calls
Snaglist.setUserEnabled(false); on calls Snaglist.setUserEnabled(true).

## Clean removal

Snaglist.destroy() removes its element, listeners and any recording, and puts back window.fetch,
XMLHttpRequest and console.error and console.warn exactly as they were.

## Deactivate for everyone

Set enabled: false in Snaglist.start() (often in snaglist-start.js), or remove the data-github, data-email and
data-endpoint attributes.

## Remove completely

Delete snaglist.js, snaglist-start.js, their <script> tags, every Snaglist.* call, the user setting and the
data-snag-private attributes. data-component attributes can stay. Search for "snaglist" and "snag-" to confirm
nothing is left.
